essence: Hari is to be visualized bearing the great seal in his hands and the radiant Kaustubha on his neck.
Hari is to be visualized as praised by invisible gods, sages, and gandharvas.
One should worship the six limbs and Hari's attendants on the petals.
Kāla, Nīla, the world-guardians, and the weapons are to be worshipped in the ground enclosure, with the rest implied.
One should offer libations with pure waters and also please the brahmins.
